# The fixed ("latest") download names: a contract with aipotluck.org.
#
# Every published release carries each installer twice: under its versioned name
# (aipotluck-local-client-gui_0.2.0_linux-x64.deb) and under the version-free name listed here
# (aipotluck-local-client-gui_linux-x64.deb). GitHub serves the release marked Latest at
#
#   https://github.com/currentai-org/aipotluck-local-client-gui/releases/latest/download/<name>
#
# and aipotluck.org's Settings -> Local inference page links exactly those URLs, so publishing a
# release updates every download link on the site with no change to the web app.
#
# Who reads this file:
#   - tools/stage-release.sh: the draft release refuses to be created unless it holds every name below
#   - tools/check-latest-links.sh (latest-links.yml, on Publish): every link must resolve to the
#     release just published
#   - tests/test_latest_links.py: this list must be exactly what the enabled targets in
#     .github/build-targets.json produce
#
# Changing it (adding, removing or renaming a name) changes what aipotluck.org can link to. Follow
# "Fixed latest download links" in docs/RELEASING.md: change this file and the web page together.
# One name per line; blank lines and lines starting with # are ignored.

aipotluck-local-client-gui_linux-x64.deb
aipotluck-local-client-gui_linux-x64.AppImage
aipotluck-local-client-gui_linux-arm64.deb
aipotluck-local-client-gui_linux-arm64.AppImage
aipotluck-local-client-gui_macos-arm64.dmg
aipotluck-local-client-gui_macos-arm64.app.zip
aipotluck-local-client-gui_macos-x64.dmg
aipotluck-local-client-gui_macos-x64.app.zip
aipotluck-local-client-gui_windows-x64.setup.exe
